items.headline: Tyler Fredricson leaves United to join FC Lausanne-Sport
items.summary: Academy defender Tyler Fredricson, 21, exits on permanent deal with Ineos-owned Swiss club. Transfer includes sell-on and buy-back clause.

items.headline: Marcus Rashford bids farewell to Barcelona after loan ends
items.summary: Barcelona did not exercise €30m option to make Rashford's loan permanent. Forward thanked club on Instagram.

items.headline: Youri Tielemans and Senne Lammens return for pre-season
items.summary: Midfielder Tielemans and defender Lammens have joined first-team training after summer break. Squad building for Champions League campaign.

items.headline: Benjamin Sesko described as 'getting there' with recovery
items.summary: Striker's injury recovery progressing positively ahead of new season. Club providing update on availability.
